questions.question: Factorise (64x⁶ - y⁶).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

64x⁶ - y⁶

**Formula used:**

a3 - b3 = (a - b) (a2 + ab + b2)

a² - b² = (a - b) (a + b)

**Calculation:**

64x6 - y6 = (4x2)3 - y6

So, (4x2)3 - (y2)3 

Since both terms are perfect cubes, factor using the difference of cubes formula: 

a³ - b³ = (a - b) (a² + ab + b²) where a = 4x² and b = y²

⇒ (4x² - y²) (4x²)² + 4x²y² + (y²)²

Rewrite 4x² as (2x)².

⇒ ((2x)2 - (y)2) ((4x2)2 + 4x2y2 + (y2)²)

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) ((4x2)2 + 4x2y2 + (y2)²)

Applying the product rule to 4x².

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) ((4²(x²)² + 4x²y² + (y²)²)

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) ((16(x2)2 + 4x2y2 + (y2)2)

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) (16x⁴ + 4x2y2 + y⁴)

Rewrite middle term of (16x4 + 4x2y2 + y4) in a factored form

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) (16x4 + 2(4x²)y2 - 4x²y² + y4)

Rearrange terms,

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) (16x4 + 2(4x2)y2 + y⁴ - 4x2y2)

Factor first three terms of (16x4 + 2(4x2)y2 + y4 - 4x2y2) by perfect square rule.

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) ((4x² + y²)² - 4x2y2)

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) ((4x2 + y2)2 - (2xy)²)

Using the difference of square formula, a2 - b2 = (a - b) (a + b).

⇒ (2x + y) (2x - y) (4x2 + y2 + 2xy) (4x2 + y2 - 2xy) 

Rearranging the terms, we get,

⇒ (2x - y)(2x + y)(4x2 + 2xy + y2)(4x2 - 2xy + y2​)

**Hence, the correct answer is option 3.**

questions.question: ________ of trade refers to the type of goods and services a country exports and imports.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Composition.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** composition of trade refers to the types of goods and services a country exports and imports.**
 
• It encompasses the** variety and complexity of products and services exchanged in international trade.**
 
• The composition can be determined by **various factors, including a country's resources, technological capabilities, industrial structure, and policies.**
 
• It reflects a **country's economic strength and competitiveness on the global stage.**
 
• Countries with a** diverse trade composition are usually more resilient to economic shocks because they don't rely on a single type or category of goods for their export earnings.**
 
• Over time, the **composition of trade can change as a country develops, diversifies its economy, or adopts new technologies.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Factors
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Volume
 
 
 
• The volume of trade refers to the quantity of goods and services traded.
 
• It doesn't tell us anything about the types of goods and services being exchanged, just the amount.
 
 
 
 

 Value
 
 
 
• The value of trade refers to the monetary worth of goods and services traded.
 
• It tells us about the total dollar value of the exports and imports, but not specifically about the types of goods and services.
 
 
 
 

 Gain
 
 
 
• The gain from trade refers to the net benefit or advantage that a country gets from participating in international trade.
 
• This could be economic (increased income, jobs), social (access to diverse goods), or strategic.
 
• It doesn't refer directly to the types of goods and services a country exports and imports.

questions.question: The price of a laptop in a shop is decreased by 35%, as a result of which the sales increased by 20%. What is the effect on the total revenue of the shop from the sale of laptops?
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

Price of a laptop decreased by 35% and sales increased by 20%.

**Calculation:**

Let the price of the laptop = n, Number of laptops sold = p

Original Revenue = np

New price = p - 35%p = 0.65p

New number of laptop sale = n + 20%n = 1.2n

New revenue = 0.65p × 1.2n 

= 0.78np

Effective revenue = New revenue - Original revenue = 0.78np - np = - 0.22np

Percentage of effective revenue = 0.22over 100 × 100 = 22%

⇒The total revenue of the shop from the sale of laptops **Decreased by 22%.**

Hence, the correct answer is** 22% decrease.**

questions.question: The lengths of corresponding sides of two similar triangles are in the ratio 5 ∶ 6. The areas of these triangles are in the ratio:
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

The lengths of the corresponding sides of two similar triangles are in the ratio 5 ∶ 6

**Concept used:**

If two triangles are similar, then the ratio of the area of both triangles is equal to the ratio of the squares of their corresponding sides.

**Calculation:**

Let the similar triangles be ABC and PQR.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a3e3619eb8743932284596c1f1e8e70634dc82f45b42db575232c9290fc6eaf.png] 

The corresponding sides of the two triangles are in the ratio AB : PQ is 5 : 6. 

This means, the ratio of areas of triangles ABC and PQR will be:

Ar( ABC) over Ar(PQR) = (AB²)/(PQ²) = ((AB)/(PQ))²

We already know that ABover PQ is equal to 5 over 6.

⇒ (5over6)² = 25over 36

Hence, the areas of these triangles are in the ratio** 25 : 36.**

questions.question: The radius of the base of a cylinder is increased from 4 cm to 16 cm, but its curved surface area remains unchanged. If the initial height of the cylinder was 4 cm, what will be its new height?

Initial radius (r) = 4 cm

Curved Surface Area of cylinder = 2πrh

Where, r = Radius of cylinder

h = Height of cylinder

**Calculation:**

Initial curved surface area = 2 × π × 4 × 4 

= 32π cm²

New curved surface area = 2 × π × 16 × H 

= 32πH cm²

As, Initial curved surface area = New curved surface area

⇒ 32π = 32πH

⇒ H = 1 cm

Hence, the new height of the cylinder is** 1 cm.**

questions.question: Two consecutive numbers are such that one-fourth of the smaller number exceeds one-fifth of the larger number by 3. The larger number is ________.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Check the given options directly to save time. The options represent the larger number.

If the larger number is 65 (Option 4), the smaller consecutive number must be 64.

One-fourth of the smaller number = 64 ÷ 4 = 16.

One-fifth of the larger number = 65 ÷ 5 = 13.

Difference = 16 − 13 = 3, which completely satisfies the given condition.

**∴ The correct answer is 65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Two consecutive numbers are given.

One-fourth of the smaller number exceeds one-fifth of the larger number by 3.

**Calculations:**

Let the smaller number be x and the larger consecutive number be (x + 1).

According to the given condition:

⇒ x/4 − (x + 1)/5 = 3

Taking the LCM of the denominators (4 and 5), which is 20:

⇒ (5x − 4(x + 1)) / 20 = 3

⇒ 5x − 4x − 4 = 60

⇒ x − 4 = 60

⇒ x = 60 + 4

⇒ x = 64

The smaller number is 64.

The larger number = x + 1

⇒ 64 + 1 = 65

**∴ The correct answer is 65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Numbers

Numbers that follow each other continuously in order from smallest to largest are called consecutive numbers. If the first number is n, the next consecutive numbers are n+1, n+2, etc.

Consecutive Even/Odd Numbers

For purely even or purely odd numbers, the difference between any two consecutive terms is always 2. Example: x, x+2, x+4.

Solving Linear Equations with Fractions

When solving equations involving fractions, multiplying the entire equation by the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of all denominators helps eliminate the fractions and simplifies calculation instantly.

questions.question: If 14 April 2005 is a Thursday, then what will be the day of the week on 10 May 2017?
questions.solution:
Given: 14 April 2005 is a Thursday.

Now, 14 April 2005 to 14 April 2017 = 12 years (3 leap and 9 ordinary year).

In 12 years = (3 × 2) + (9 × 1) = 6 + 9 = 15 days.

And, from 14 April 2017 to 10 May 2017 = 16(April) + 10(May) = 26 days.

So, total number of days = 15 + 26 = 41 days.

Total odd days in 41 days = 41/7 = 5 week and 6 odd days.

So, 10 May 2017 = Thursday + 6 = Wednesday.

Hence, The correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given: 14 April 2005 is a Thursday

Concept:

No. of odd days in non-leap year = Remainder of (365 ÷ 7) = 1 odd day

No. of odd days in leap year = Remainder of (366 ÷ 7) = 2 odd day

After every 7 days and multiple of 7 days, the days repeat themselves.

so when we cross years we need to check whether the given year is a leap or not. The particular day of a year is increased by 1 or 2 odd days on the same day of the next year.

Calculation:

Total number of days in a normal year = 365

Total number of days in a leap year = 366

Total number of odd days in a normal year = 365/7 = 1 

Total number of odd days in a leap year = 366/7 = 2

No of days from 15 April 2005 to 31 Dec 2005 = 16 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 261 days

No of odd days from 15 April 2005 to 31 Dec 2005 = 261/7 = 2 days

No of days from 1 Jan 2017 to 10 May 2017 = 31 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 10 = 130 days

No of odd days from 1 Jan 2017 to 10 May 2017 = 130/7 = 4 days

No of odd days from 15 April 2005 to 10 May 2017 = (2 + 4 + (1 × 8) + (2 × 3))/7 = 20/7 = 6 days as 2008, 2012, and 2016 are leap years.

Now, 14 April 2005 (Thursday) + 6 odd days = 10 May 2017 (Wednesday)

Hence, 10th May 2017 will be Wednesday.
